quick_skim.title: DMSNet: Cross-Band Learning for Multi-Target Sensing in Multi-Band ISAC
quick_skim.abstract: Multi-band integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) offers complementary high- and low-frequency echo information for multi-target sensing. However, existing dual-band ISAC sensing methods have a limited ability to exploit deep complementary information across heterogeneous bands and often incur high computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose a Dual-Band Multi-Target Sensing Neural Network (DMSNet) for joint target number and parameter estimation. Under representative simulation conditions, DMSNet outperforms the best baseline in target number estimation, increasing count accuracy from 89.01 % to 91.74 % and Macro-F1 from 90.80 % to 93.07 %. For parameter estimation, compared with the best baselines, DMSNet reduces the median absolute errors of range, velocity, and angle by 82.2%, 56.9%, and 73.2%, respectively. Moreover, DMSNet reduces runtime by 68.7 % relative to the fastest existing dual-band ISAC sensing method.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes DMSNet for dual-band multi-target sensing using cross-band learning, achieving 91.74% count accuracy and reducing parameter estimation error.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该论文针对多波段集成感知与通信(ISAC)中利用高频和低频回波互补信息进行多目标感知的问题，提出了双波段多目标感知神经网络(DMSNet)。DMSNet通过跨波段学习有效融合异质波段信息，在仿真条件下将目标数量估计准确率从89.01%提升至91.74%，并显著降低了参数估计误差。该方法虽然应用于无线通信场景，但其利用高频特征的思路对水下目标识别具有方法论上的借鉴意义。
